name: huizhi-dsh
description: 企业智慧中枢的 Ubuntu DSH 命令行执行器和插件接入层

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/*.test.js test/weknora-p0-audit.test.mjs
scripts.routing-demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js dispatch --input examples/command-save.json --context examples/context-mobile.json --adapter examples/routing-demo-adapter.mjs --format text
scripts.provider-error-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/provider-error-smoke.mjs 401 && node scripts/provider-error-smoke.mjs 429
scripts.setup: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js setup
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js doctor
scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run
